title: micromeria parviflora
intro: Micromeria parviflora, commonly known as Alpine Whortleberry or Dwarf Thyme, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate digestive issues, boost the immune system, and exhibit wound-healing properties. The therapeutic actions of Micromeria parviflora are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to possess anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and neuroprotective effects. Further research is necessary to fully understand the efficacy and safety of Micromeria parviflora for medicinal use.
